reviewType: Independent read-only source review and assertions over actual UI branches; no mirrored UI state machine.

assertions.name: automatic_capture_failure_consumes_hint_once
assertions.evidence: MainWindow.Follow.cs:139-150: pending hint cleared before capture; false branch does not enqueue it again.

assertions.name: log_changes_or_read_gaps_invalidate_prior_advice
assertions.evidence: MainWindow.Follow.cs:111-115 consumes the actual service review flag and cancels prior work.

assertions.name: service_marks_all_observed_log_discontinuities
assertions.evidence: LogFollowService.cs returns RequiresReview on rotation/truncation/missing file/read gaps/overlong lines/timeout/IO failure.

assertions.name: following_is_explicit_and_disabled_at_start
assertions.evidence: InitializeFollowing loads preferences and installs a timer handler; it does not start the timer or session. Checked event explicitly calls StartFollowing.

assertions.name: following_session_and_shutdown_guard
assertions.evidence: FollowTick continuation checks session identity/token/generation; Closing stops the follower and cancels capture/advice.

assertions.name: selected_window_retains_process_identity
assertions.evidence: NativeCapture checks PID before/after capture and excludes the helper; RefreshSources compares HWND and PID.

assertions.name: automatic_capture_rejects_full_screen_and_nonforeground
assertions.evidence: CanAutoCapture rejects zero HWND and nonforeground; CaptureGame repeats eligibility around pixel reading.

assertions.name: capture_result_is_not_reported_as_new_without_frame
assertions.evidence: The actual capture API returns a guarded bool; FollowTick distinguishes false from a new screenshot.

assertions.name: stale_advice_does_not_publish_after_cancel_or_change
assertions.evidence: MainWindow.Advice.cs:24-42 clears the prior result before Task.Run and guards publication with cancellation/revision/closing.

assertions.name: manual_confirmation_stays_mandatory
assertions.evidence: Pending log hints block recommendation; input collection plus core validation requires manual confirmation after every invalidation/new frame.

assertions.name: failed_simulation_does_not_silently_use_instant_mode
assertions.evidence: Immediate scoring occurs only in the explicitly selected ternary branch. Simulation exceptions display incomplete status; zero paired rounds throw.

assertions.name: only_complete_terminal_trajectories_enter_paired_statistics
assertions.evidence: Rollout catches budget expiry before committing a candidate batch; PlayoutCore only returns Vault after terminal state and throws at action cap.

assertions.name: statistics_distinguish_total_outcome_and_uncertainty
assertions.evidence: Outcome is total terminal Vault including current captures; n<2 does not invent zero standard error. UI names total rather than marginal gain.

assertions.name: unseen_information_is_not_exposed_as_observed
assertions.evidence: Observe gates potential event existence and type on Seen; private tier/species also require confirmed/scouted knowledge. Continuation policy only receives Observe().

assertions.name: log_reader_is_readonly_and_handles_transient_locked_start
assertions.evidence: Game log is opened read-only/shared. A file locked during connection recovers at EOF rather than replaying preconnection history.

assertions.name: new_runtime_paths_have_no_network_client_or_remote_site_loader
assertions.evidence: New core/follow/capture/advice sources contain no HTTP/socket/browser-loader entry points. Existing updater networking remains explicit UI actions.

assertions.name: new_managed_settings_remain_beneath_launch_data_root
assertions.evidence: Follow preferences are stored atomically at LaunchContext.DataRoot/log-follow.json; calibration remains under the same existing data root.

assertions.name: stable_host_updater_storage_sources_preserved
assertions.evidence: Compared stable product source hashes with delivered 0.4.3 build report; no stable-host/updater/storage source changes.

assertions.name: append_does_not_use_linux_ctime_as_rotation_identity
assertions.evidence: LogTailReader:71-80 uses length/prefix/offset anchors. Ordinary appends preserve incomplete UTF8 decoder state; no ctime-based false rotation reset.

assertions.name: pending_global_event_survives_actor_removed_by_reward
assertions.evidence: GameAdvisor permits nonoffice events without a remaining actor. NormalizePhase no longer drops an unresolved event when that actor banks; actor-only effects explicitly no-op while global effects continue.

assertions.name: resealed_current_room_future_marker_survives_pending_global_event
assertions.evidence: FromObserved deduplicates only the same/unknown current incident on an open room. A resealed door future marker is preserved independently; ResolveEvent clears ActiveEvent rather than that new marker.

assertions.name: seen_roundtrips_through_actual_editor_and_new_frames_reset_it
assertions.evidence: Main table explicitly exposes event-presence knowledge, LoadState preserves it, UiModels.ToState collects it, and each new screenshot resets it for human review. Tooltip distinguishes this from knowing inmate quality.

assertions.name: unseen_sampling_does_not_override_confirmed_event_absence
assertions.evidence: Only unseen unmarked locked doors receive the approximate 5% hidden event sample; Seen=true/Event=false remains confirmed absence. Observe hides sampled presence until revealed.

resolvedFindings.issue: HWND-only capture identity and source refresh could accept a recycled handle.
resolvedFindings.resolution: CaptureTarget now records PID, capture revalidates it, helper process is excluded, refresh compares HWND and PID.

resolvedFindings.issue: Automatic capture failure requeued an unchanged trigger and retried every 750 ms.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Trigger is consumed before the attempt. Failed capture waits for a new log event or manual F8; a not-yet-attempted background hint may wait for foreground.

resolvedFindings.issue: A successful log read could contain discontinuities without a matched event.
resolvedFindings.resolution: RequiresReview covers truncation/rotation/missing/IO/read gaps/overlong lines/settle timeout and the UI clears old advice.

resolvedFindings.issue: An actor banked by a queued gift could cause the still-pending global event to disappear.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Nonoffice event states may have no remaining actor; event normalization retains ActiveEvent until accept/skip. Actor-only effects explicitly have no actor effect.

resolvedFindings.issue: A newly resealed current room could hold a future marker alongside an earlier unresolved event.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current incident deduplication is restricted to an open room same/unknown marker; resolving the outer event does not erase the new future marker.

resolvedFindings.issue: Linux ctime can change during ordinary appends and falsely reset a partially decoded log.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reader uses length/prefix/offset content anchors and keeps UTF8 decoder state for ordinary appends.

resolvedFindings.issue: Event-presence knowledge was not preserved by the editor, and private sampled event presence must not leak.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Seen is now an explicit editor field with LoadState/ToState roundtrip and new-frame reset; hidden sampling respects confirmed absence and Observe gates presence/type on Seen.

reviewedIntegration: Ordinary twenty-day simulator phases: patrol/manage/office/event/tool/gift/chain/ratway, terminal completion and supported mechanics validation.
Finite paired rollout sampling, model-private hidden information, full-round commits, cancellation, time/action limits and no silent heuristic fallback.
Explicit opt-in read-only log following, bounded incremental decoding, local-only preferences and generation-safe UI consumption.
Game-window capture identity, foreground/minimized/cloaked checks, pixel rejection, GDI cleanup and conditional screen fallback.
Closing/cancel/source change/import/new screenshot/manual edits invalidate old recommendations; manual confirmation remains required.
Final delta review: no-actor pending global events, resealed-door future markers, Seen UI roundtrip/private event presence, and append-safe log rotation checks.
remainingLimitations: Linux source review and cross-build do not establish actual Windows screenshot, focus, DPI, overlay, hotkey or dialog behavior.
PrintWindow is a synchronous native call and cannot be fully interrupted by CancellationToken; preflight hung-window checks reduce but do not eliminate stalls.
Screen fallback obstruction checks are conservative and are not a universal protection against every overlay/rendering case.
Window title plus the explicitly selected HWND/PID is not cryptographic verification of the game executable.
Built-in log phrases are independently written candidates, not validated country/client log signatures; unknown logs may require custom local phrases or manual F8.
Rollout means and standard errors apply only to the approximate supported-rule model; future unsupported tools/mechanics, real-game probability error and global optimality are not covered.

Log rotation/replacement recognition uses bounded content anchors and length, not a perfect cross-platform OS file identity; replacements indistinguishable at sampled anchors cannot be universally detected.
